functions.mc_math_func_exp2f:
entry:
  %cmp = fcmp contract olt float %x, -1.260000e+02
  %cond = select contract i1 %cmp, float 6.400000e+01, float 0.000000e+00
  %add = fadd contract float %cond, %x
  %0 = tail call contract float @llvm.exp2.f32(float %add)
  %cond2 = select contract i1 %cmp, float 0x3BF0000000000000, float 1.000000e+00
  %mul = fmul contract float %cond2, %0
  ret float %mul

decision: Directed IEEE reciprocal modes add rounding-register operations around the same division; do not benchmark. Public powf uses builtin exp2 under fast math and is investigated separately.
